combos.title: Reanimated `3.x` + any `react-native-worklets` installed
combos.what_broke: Official docs: “Reanimated 3 will not work with `react-native-worklets` installed.”

combos.title: Reanimated `4.y` + Worklets minor outside docs “yes” cell
combos.what_broke: Version mismatch — Worklet version validation / peer range reject (introduced Reanimated `4.0.0`; tightened later)
combos.forces_or_breaks: Bumping Reanimated minor often **breaks** previous Worklets minor (e.g. `4.6`→`4.7` drops `0.12` for `0.13`)
combos.fixed_in: fixed by aligning to the yes-cell for that Reanimated minor (see eras in INDEX)

combos.title: Reanimated `4.x` + React Native New Architecture (Fabric)
combos.forces_or_breaks: Adopting Reanimated 4 **forces** New Architecture; old-arch apps must stay on Reanimated 3

combos.title: Reanimated `4.x` + React Native Old Architecture (Paper)
combos.what_broke: Reanimated 4 does not support Paper / old architecture
combos.forces_or_breaks: Staying on Paper **breaks** upgrade to Reanimated 4
combos.fixed_in: still-open — use Reanimated 3 (maintenance mode) on Paper

combos.title: Reanimated `4.7.x` + RN `0.86`–`0.88`
combos.forces_or_breaks: Bumping to `4.7` **breaks** RN `<0.86` and **forces** RN in `0.86–0.88`

combos.title: Reanimated `4.6.x` + RN `0.88` (incl. `0.88.0-rc.*`)
combos.what_broke: Declared peer range stops at `0.87`; SWM compatibility table marks `4.6.x` × `0.88` = **no**. Installs against RN 0.88 emit peer warnings / are unsupported by SWM matrix.
combos.forces_or_breaks: Expo SDK 58 preview animation pin **forces peer-range tension** vs RN 0.88 RC; navigator should prefer SWM peers/docs over Expo preview pin when answering “does 4.6 support 0.88?”
combos.fixed_in: still-open while on `4.6.x` — move to Reanimated `4.7.x` + Worklets `0.13.x`, or wait for Expo to re-pin; do **not** treat Expo preview pin as peer-compliant

combos.title: Worklets `0.12.x` + RN `0.88` (incl. `0.88.0-rc.*`)
combos.what_broke: Worklets `0.12.2` peers `react-native`: `0.83 - 0.87` — excludes 0.88. Paired with Expo 58 preview pin `0.12.2` + RN `0.88.0-rc.1`.
combos.forces_or_breaks: Staying on Expo-pinned Worklets `0.12.2` under RN 0.88 **breaks** peer satisfaction; aligns with Reanimated `4.6` window, not `4.7`

combos.fixed_in: still-open for `4.2+` vs RN 0.78 — stay on `4.1.x` (docs: `4.1.x` supports 0.78) or upgrade RN
